A Small Paper for Testing

Abstract. We test the text layer of a PDF: one line per page marker, and the references cut.

1 Introduction. The method improves the baseline from 41.2 to 47.9 points (Table 1).

2 Results. Table 1: accuracy of the method, 47.9, and of the baseline, 41.2.
